{{Quote|Have you ever heard of the Sennex? They're a bad lot, worse than the Hutts, and I say that with all due respect.|[[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]]|<ref name="SWG:JPEM" />}}
The '''Sennex Compound''' was a compound on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] used by the criminal organization known as the [[Sennex]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located a relatively short distance east of the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]].<ref name="SWG:JPEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with going to the compound, and disrupting Sennex's operations. The spacer succeeded in doing so by [[Death/Legends|killing]] a swath of Sennex foot [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including at least sixteen of their [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], six [[Slaver/Legends|slave masters]], and nine guards. The spacer also obtained key chips from the guards and wiped the central computer of the compound of all information.<ref name="SWG:JPEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sennex Compound was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sennex Compound was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPEM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
